structured_output.mechanisms: Time ≈ 0.2s overhead + steps × per-step cost; per-step cost is a fixed part plus a part proportional to conv FLOPs (sum of squared stage widths), scaled by resolution² and batch size. Cutout adds a little. Accuracy rises with log(epochs) and with model capacity (width), and falls with heavy regularization (cutout, label smoothing 0.2) at short schedules and with random instead of alternating flip.
